import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolTransforms

# Fragment: Ru + Cl + bidentate P,N ligand (N of dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine ring, P of vinyl-P(tBu)2)
smiF = "CC1=CC=C2C(=N1)N([Ru](Cl)P(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C)C(=CP(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C)C=C2"
molF = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiF, sanitize=False)
print("F atoms:", molF.GetNumAtoms())
molF = Chem.Mol(molF)
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(molF, randomSeed=42, useRandomCoords=True)
confF = molF.GetConformer()
coordsF = confF.GetPositions()
elsF = [a.GetSymbol() for a in molF.GetAtoms()]
# find indices
sym = elsF
iRu = sym.index('Ru'); iCl = sym.index('Cl')
# N bonded to Ru
iN = [b.GetOtherAtomIdx(a) for a in [molF.GetAtomWithIdx(iRu)] for b in a.GetBonds() if molF.GetAtomWithIdx(b.GetOtherAtomIdx()).GetSymbol()=='N'][0]
iP = [b.GetOtherAtomIdx(b2) for b2 in molF.GetAtomWithIdx(iRu).GetBonds() if molF.GetAtomWithIdx(b2.GetOtherAtomIdx()).GetSymbol()=='P'][0]
print("iRu,iCl,iN,iP", iRu,iCl,iN,iP)
coordsF = coordsF - coordsF[iRu]

# p-cymene
molC = Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC(C)c1ccc(C)cc1")
molC = Chem.AddHs(molC)
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(molC, randomSeed=7)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(molC)
coordsC = molC.GetConformer().GetPositions()
elsC = [a.GetSymbol() for a in molC.GetAtoms()]
ringidx = [a.GetIdx() for a in molC.GetAtoms() if a.IsInRing() and a.GetSymbol()=='C']
print("ring idx", ringidx)
cent = coordsC[ringidx].mean(axis=0)
# ring normal via SVD
X = coordsC[ringidx] - cent
u,s,vt = np.linalg.svd(X)
n = vt[2]
n = n/np.linalg.norm(n)

# target: direction opposite to mean of Cl,N,P unit vectors
dvec = np.mean([coordsF[i]/np.linalg.norm(coordsF[i]) for i in (iCl,iN,iP)], axis=0)
dvec = dvec/np.linalg.norm(dvec)
target_n = -dvec          # ring normal direction (from centroid toward Ru is -target_n?) centroid = -dvec*1.68
centroid_target = -dvec*1.68

# rotation mapping n -> target_n
def rot_from_to(a,b):
    a=a/np.linalg.norm(a); b=b/np.linalg.norm(b)
    v=np.cross(a,b); c=np.dot(a,b)
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-9:
        return np.eye(3) if c>0 else None
    vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    R=np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*(1/(1+c))
    return R
R = rot_from_to(n, target_n)
coordsC2 = (coordsC - cent) @ R.T + centroid_target

# combine
elems = elsF + elsC
coords = np.vstack([coordsF, coordsC2])
print("total atoms", len(elems))
with open('complex_init.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{len(elems)}\ninitial Ru complex\n")
    for e,c in zip(elems, coords):
        f.write(f"{e} {c[0]:.6f} {c[1]:.6f} {c[2]:.6f}\n")
# report indices of arene carbons in combined file
off = len(elsF)
print("arene C indices:", [off+i for i in ringidx])
print("iRu,iCl,iN,iP:", iRu,iCl,iN,iP)
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(elems))
EOF
